mods.name: Figura Flashback
mods.description: Flashback replays keep the Figura avatars that were worn while recording, and hidden players are not drawn at all.

releases.notes:
## 0.1.0 — first release

- Flashback replays keep **the Figura avatars worn while recording** — no more `/figura netlock` and `/figura nonhost_load` by hand. Avatars go into each snapshot (in full once, then by hash) and avatar re-uploads during the recording are inserted at that moment.
- Opening a replay locks network avatars right away; avatars put on by hand (the core's wardrobe for other players, `nonhost_load`) always win.
- Players hidden with "Hide During Export" are **not drawn at all** in replays — body, Figura parts (world parts included), name tag, shadow and held items.
- Requires Fabric API, MCmod_Figura_quadaFork `0.1.6.5` or later and Flashback `0.39.10` or later. Install on both the recording PC and the PC that opens the replay.

---

- 리플레이에 **녹화 당시 Figura 아바타**가 들어간다 — 손으로 `netlock` · `nonhost_load` 할 일이 없다 · 녹화 도중 다시 올린 아바타도 그 시점에
- 리플레이를 열면 곧바로 네트워크 잠금 · 손으로 입힌 아바타가 늘 이긴다
- 숨긴 플레이어는 **아예 안 그린다**(몸 · Figura 파츠 · 월드 파츠 · 이름표 · 그림자 · 든 아이템)
- 필요: Fabric API · 코어 포크 `0.1.6.5` 이상 · Flashback `0.39.10` 이상 · 녹화 PC · 재생 PC 둘 다
